findings.text: FS-SELECT-v1 selects no Fs from either job. In J3 and in J3b, all 4 replicas are Q0-valid and pass Q1 (finite, 256 updates), Q2 (0 clip events, max per-visit ratio 1.0000, no epoch-mean onset), Q3 (8/8 issues improved), Q4 (train 24h: J3 m 0.910518 / max r_i 0.924608; J3b m 0.929409 / max r_i 0.938387) and Q5 (train 72h: J3 1.000934; J3b 0.995181). Every replica FAILs Q6 (holdout 24h mean ratio <= 1.02): J3 1.038925, J3b 1.020438. J3b misses by 0.000438; training is bitwise deterministic here (J3-F2), so this is an exact value, not run-to-run noise. FS-BUDGET-v1: J3b was run because J3 was FAIL; with J3b also FAIL there is no further pre-registered Fs job, and J4 (freeze/certify) is not reached.

Under the S0-certified execution (official Stormer + xformers 0.0.27, torch 2.3.1+cu121, TF32 off), Fs training is bitwise reproducible across the 4 H100s and across jobs: the 4 J3 replicas equal J2 arm A2 exactly (every loss, grad norm, per-factor grad norm, final adapter digest, adapter file sha256 172cbfddd281eb38..., and all F0/L0/L1 panels); the 4 J3b replicas equal J2 arm A3 exactly (adapter sha256 c656026b3c54872b...); J1 arm A0's 32 updates equal J2 arm A0's first 32. By contrast the uncertified historical runs diverged between replicas from update 1 (pt-e8y7ib01, TF32 off: ~1e-8 relative at update 1, >1e-3 by updates 99-105; TF32-on jobs: >1e-3 by updates 54-72). So the original brief's 'GPU float nondeterminism decides which replica falls over' describes the uncertified execution path only; under the certified path the FS-SELECT-v1 witnesses are exact reproductions and replica outcomes cannot differ. The mechanism (which kernel's backward was nondeterministic before) is not verified here and is not claimed.

Both learning rates improve every one of the 8 TRAINING issues at the trained 24h lead, and make every one of the 8 HELD-OUT issues worse at 24h. Holdout mean ratios J3 (lr 2.5e-3): 6h 1.039160, 24h 1.038925 (per-issue 1.0287-1.0578), 72h 1.099221; J3b (lr 1.25e-3): 6h 1.022742, 24h 1.020438 (per-issue 1.0163-1.0301), 72h 1.061759. Holdout 6h and 72h are report-only (Q5 guards the TRAIN panel at 72h). Halving the lr shrinks the train-24h gain (-8.9% -> -7.1%) and the holdout harm (+3.9% -> +2.0% at 24h) together. Interpretation: with 8 training issues, a 24h-only objective and 49,152 adapter parameters, the static adapter learns issue-specific 24h corrections that do not transfer to nearby issue times; lowering lr alone does not change that trade-off enough to pass Q6.

STOP_FITTED_FS_QUALITY (CLAUDE_OPUSPLAN_EXECUTION_PROMPT Stage 1; STOP_CONDITIONS section 2: Fs quality not closed -> downstream BLOCKED). No reference_manifest or Fs certificate is published; FP-04+ stay locked. This is a failure of this 8-issue, 24h-objective static adapter under FS-QUAL-v1, not a finding that the EarthDelta idea is scientifically invalid (STOP_CONDITIONS section 3: allowed INCONCLUSIVE_QUALIFICATION vs observed degradation; here the holdout degradation is observed). Budget used: J1, J2, J3, J3b (4 of 5 scientific jobs), 0 infra retries. Anything further needs protocol v2 and user approval (FS-BUDGET-v1).
